incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted after database pool_size reduction in pagos-core
incidents.symptoms: Transferencias p95 latency climbing rapidly; pagos-core logs Connection pool exhausted waiting for pagos-db
incidents.root_cause: Configuration deployment lowered DB connection pool_size below steady-state concurrency
incidents.resolution: Rollback the pool configuration change to restore previous pool_size

incidents.title: Latency spike in Transferencias caused by pagos-core connection pool saturation
incidents.symptoms: Connection pool exhausted errors in pagos-core and elevated authorize latency in transferencias
incidents.root_cause: Pool limit tuned down during maintenance release
incidents.resolution: Immediate rollback of pool configuration change per RB-087

incidents.title: SMTP relay rate limiting on outbound email notifications
incidents.symptoms: 421 Too many concurrent SMTP connections in notification worker
incidents.root_cause: Bulk marketing campaign burst exceeded relay quota
incidents.resolution: Enable exponential backoff and throttle batch worker concurrency

incidents.title: Expired TLS leaf certificate on internal OAuth token endpoint
incidents.symptoms: SSLHandshakeException and 502 Bad Gateway on token introspection
incidents.root_cause: Automated ACME certificate renewal hook failed due to DNS TXT propagation delay
incidents.resolution: Rotate TLS certificate manually and restart ingress pods

incidents.title: Kafka consumer group lag growing on ledger.entries topic
incidents.symptoms: Consumer lag above 50k messages and delayed balance updates
incidents.root_cause: Poison pill message triggered repeated deserialization retries
incidents.resolution: Route malformed payload to dead-letter topic and scale consumer replicas

incidents.title: Redis cluster cache eviction storm causing model feature timeouts
incidents.symptoms: Evicted_keys spike in Redis and fallback to cold scoring path
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded session key TTL omitted in feature writer v2.4
incidents.resolution: Apply TTL patch and flush stale prefix keys

incidents.title: DNS lookup timeouts resolving external SWIFT gateway
incidents.root_cause: CoreDNS node-local cache pod evicted under memory pressure
incidents.resolution: Reschedule CoreDNS pods with higher memory limit

incidents.title: PostgreSQL sequential scan regression after missing composite index
incidents.symptoms: High CPU on read replica and slow account statement queries

incidents.title: JVM OldGen GC pause spikes in card tokenization service
incidents.root_cause: Large audit payload buffered in heap before compression
incidents.resolution: Stream audit payloads and increase heap headroom

incidents.title: Third-party biometric vendor HTTP 429 throttling
incidents.symptoms: Document verification failures during onboarding peak
incidents.root_cause: Missing client-side token bucket rate limiter
incidents.resolution: Enable circuit breaker and queue non-urgent verifications

incidents.title: Thread pool starvation from unconfigured HTTP client read timeouts
incidents.symptoms: Worker threads blocked indefinitely on slow merchant callback URLs
incidents.root_cause: Default infinite socket timeout on webhook client

incidents.title: Clock skew across Kubernetes nodes broke HMAC signature validation
incidents.symptoms: 401 Unauthorized on valid QR payment callbacks
incidents.root_cause: NTP daemon stopped on two worker nodes
incidents.resolution: Restart chronyd and drain affected nodes

incidents.title: Stale exchange rate feed due to SFTP credential rotation
incidents.symptoms: Alert on rate freshness older than 30 minutes
incidents.root_cause: Provider rotated SSH key without updating secret store
incidents.resolution: Update SSH public key in Vault and trigger manual sync

incidents.title: Disk full on log forwarder buffer volume
incidents.symptoms: Log shipping stalled and FluentBit backpressure warnings
incidents.root_cause: Debug logging accidentally enabled in production
incidents.resolution: Revert log level to INFO and expand buffer PVC

incidents.title: Brotli compression CPU saturation on gateway ingress
incidents.symptoms: Ingress pod CPU throttling and slow static JSON responses
incidents.root_cause: Compression level bumped to 11 on dynamic API routes

incidents.title: Deadlock on concurrent end-of-day batch reconciliation jobs
incidents.symptoms: SQLSTATE 40P01 deadlock detected in settlement table
incidents.root_cause: Two cron schedules overlapped after timezone DST change
incidents.resolution: Acquire advisory lock and stagger cron schedule
